component.name: Sherlock
component.summary: Search applications, files, and the web from one small window

description.p: A small search window in the spirit of classic Mac OS Sherlock. Type, and results update from three channels: installed applications, files (using plocate or Tracker when available, or a short folder scan), and a single "Search the web" action that opens DuckDuckGo in your browser.
Sherlock does not download or scrape web pages.
